title: Animal Cruelty (General)
key_points: Overdriving, overloading, torturing, cruelly beating, needlessly mutilating or killing an animal, or failing to provide necessary care.
elements: The suspect overdrove, tormented, tortured, cruelly beat or needlessly mutilated or killed a living animal, OR failed to provide necessary care
The suspect acted purposely, knowingly or recklessly (or, for failure of care, had charge or custody of the animal)
